protocol_note: Read SEM-wake, HARNESS-FACTS, the FIX-wake table and each fix's steps/who-runs-it before the arguments; the session was cut by the 15:43 PC freeze after that reading and before writing; the attack list (section 1) was formed before the arguments were read and was written first on resume. No command or model was run.

verdicts.FX-W1: stands with a change: judge slot liveness by PowerShell outside the run lock (re-read slot bytes inside, breakStale pattern); proc.alive has a 30 s timeout (lib.mjs:2759) so hold 1 starves every writer exactly when the list is unavailable
verdicts.FX-W2: stands with a change: nonce by exclusive create with refusal on reuse and outcome at >= reconcile start; an 'abandoned' marker so a late present exit waits alarm_ms (else slow starts give a turn-per-turn wake chain)
verdicts.FX-W3: stands with a change: exempt revocation acts (fence, stop, session stop) from requireArmed; lease-only check inside the lock so hook and script agree; turn boundary not from transcript tail (notification records would livelock the hook); turn.json ce check
verdicts.FX-W4: stands with a change: fresh = FX-W3's armed predicate (alarm slots only), not alarm-or-watcher; task needs wake-to-run (PC sleeps after 15 idle min, grace is 30) and a logged-on desktop for the alert
verdicts.FX-W5: stands with a change: cap the interval (60 ticks), not the exponent; no re-raise for rows status calls owner (zombie-over)
verdicts.FX-W6: falls as written: idle+ping loops forever, ping starts child turns, ping ledger line is the coordinator's unverifiable claim, no ping means a true hang is never fenced, B2 refunds make RestartLimit unbounded; reduced form stands (epoch tick, per-state deadlines, idle not a hang, confirm by waiting, refunds capped)
verdicts.FX-W7: stands with a change: break watcher.lock only under the run lock and assertHeld+write inside the run-lock hold (a real fence); one watcher lease shared with FX-W1/FX-W4
